rules.pngBaseline: Direct PNG download is already supported by generated preview files and does not require canvas export.
rules.canvasInput: Any browser-side conversion must use the PNG preview URL as the image input.
rules.corsRequired: Cross-origin image data drawn into canvas requires CORS approval from the asset host.
rules.crossOriginAnonymous: The image element must set crossOrigin to anonymous before assigning the source URL.
rules.toBlobNullHandling: toBlob may pass null if an image cannot be created and may throw SecurityError for a non-origin-clean canvas.
rules.jpegWebpOptional: Browsers are required to support PNG export, while JPEG and WebP support is browser-dependent.
rules.unsupportedFallback: If a browser falls back to another MIME type, the UI must treat that format as unsupported.
rules.svgInternalOnly: SVG is retained for internal future coloring tools and is not a user-facing download format.
